headline: Turkish Defense and Aerospace Exports Maintain Continuous Growth Since 2020
summary: Turkey's ongoing investments in the defense and aerospace sectors have sustained consecutive annual increases in export volumes since 2020.
why: Defense exports represent a high-value manufacturing segment that supports industrial output and national export diversification.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Consistent export growth strengthens sector revenues and industrial expansion.
